SolderShape

Original code, documentation, media and project-authored design files use the MIT license. Third-party content retains its own terms. A design license is not fabrication approval, physical validation or an upstream endorsement.

ULX3S board

Board by EMARD and the ULX3S contributors. The source is pinned to commit 6a92cec6b177191c5b0f80e260013a1f8ec147dd. The complete native front view retains the original EMARD, RADIONA and FER top-silkscreen logos.

The original modified MIT notice contains the separate logo-preservation condition. The board authors do not endorse the hypothetical solder comparison. This package is not a ULX3S fabrication release. Original board bytes, attribution and mapping are retained in the recorded example.

Surface Evolver

The numerical engine and BGA force methods are Ken Brakke's work. See Surface Evolver and the BGA tutorial. SolderShape uses this existing numerical capability. Setup downloads pinned upstream archives and builds locally; this site does not redistribute the native engine binary or C source.

The engine source has component-specific notices. The full provenance note identifies that limitation rather than asserting that every upstream source line has one uniform license.

KiCad example footprint

The local workbench includes a KiCad community BGA footprint under CC-BY-SA 4.0 with its electronic-design exception. The original library notice remains separate from the project MIT license. The Board example shown here instead uses a pad extracted from the original ULX3S source.

Product media

The screenshots are actual application captures. The video is a 36-second sequence of six still captures, without audio. Its editorial pauses are not solver timings. The transcript describes the same sequence. No synthetic physical measurement, customer testimonial or manufacturing outcome is presented.
